This page lists 68 Alacritty Terminal keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `alacritty.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Alacritty Terminal to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t alacritty.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/alacritty.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Alacritty.app`; if Alacritty Terminal lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## General

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘C` | Copy |
| `⌘V` | Paste |
| `⌘K` | Clear history |
| `⌘H` | Hide |
| `⌘⌥H` | Hide other applications |
| `⌘M` | Minimize |
| `⌘Q` | Quit |
| `⌘W` | Quit |
| `⌘N` | Create new window |

## Tabs

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘T` | Create new tab |
| `⇧⌘]` | Select next tab |
| `⇧⌘[` | Select previous tab |
| `⌘⇥` | Select next tab |
| `⇧⌘⇥` | Select previous tab |
| `⌘1-8` | Select tab 1-8 |
| `⌘9` | Select last tab |

## Font Size

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘0` | Reset font size |
| `⌘=` | Increase font size |
| `⌘+` | Increase font size |
| `⌘-` | Decrease font size |

## Display

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃⌘F` | Toggle fullscreen |

## Search

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘F` | Search forward |
| `⌘B` | Search backward |

## Scrolling

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⇞` | Scroll page up |
| `⇧⇟` | Scroll page down |
| `⇧Home` | Scroll to top |
| `⇧End` | Scroll to bottom |

## Vi Mode

Press ⌃⇧Space to toggle Vi mode.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃⇧Space` | Toggle Vi mode |
| `⎋` | Clear selection (Vi) |
| `I` | Exit Vi mode |
| `⌃Y` | Scroll line up |
| `⌃E` | Scroll line down |
| `G` | Scroll to top |
| `⇧G` | Scroll to bottom |
| `⌃B` | Scroll page up |
| `⌃F` | Scroll page down |
| `⌃U` | Scroll half page up |
| `⌃D` | Scroll half page down |
| `Y` | Copy and clear selection |
| `V` | Toggle normal selection |
| `⇧V` | Toggle line selection |
| `⌃V` | Toggle block selection |
| `⌥V` | Toggle semantic selection |
| `⏎` | Open |
| `Z` | Center around Vi cursor |
| `H/J/K/L` | Left/Down/Up/Right |
| `0` | First column |
| `$` | Last column |
| `^` | First occupied |
| `⇧H` | High |
| `⇧M` | Middle |
| `⇧L` | Low |
| `B` | Semantic left |
| `W` | Semantic right |
| `E` | Semantic right end |
| `/` | Search forward |
| `?` | Search backward |
| `N` | Search next |
| `⇧N` | Search previous |

## Search Mode

When search is active.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⏎` | Confirm search |
| `⎋` | Cancel search |
| `⌃C` | Cancel search |
| `⌃U` | Clear search |
| `⌃W` | Delete word |
| `⌃P` | Previous search history |
| `⌃N` | Next search history |
| `↑` | Previous search history |
| `↓` | Next search history |

## Template file

The full [`alacritty.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/alacritty.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
